Comic Zone User Guide

Comic Reader

Read comics your way: page-by-page or continuously, with fit and zoom controls, keyboard navigation, reading progress, and manga setup.

ContentsReader overview Opening a comic Single and Continuous modes Page navigation Fit and zoom Manga setup and right-to-left reading Double-page spreads Reading progress Troubleshooting and tips Quick reference

1. Reader overview

The Comic Zone reader opens comic pages directly within your library workspace. Its toolbar lets you choose a reading layout, move between pages, change the image fit, and zoom.

2. Opening a comic

From your library or a Smart List, open a comic to display it in the reader. The comic appears in its own tab, alongside Home and List. Select that tab to return to the comic while it remains open; use the tab’s × to close it.

3. Single and Continuous modes

Single displays one page at a time. Use the previous/next buttons or supported keyboard shortcuts to move through the comic.

Continuous displays pages in a scrollable reading view. Scroll to continue reading without switching individual pages.

Switch modes using the Single / Continuous segmented control at the top of the reader.

4. Page navigation

In Single mode, use the left and right arrow controls beside the page counter. The counter displays your current page and the total, such as 1 / 21.

The reader also displays a shortcut hint: ← / → to navigate and Space for the next page. When reading in Continuous mode, scroll through the pages; the counter can reflect the currently visible page.

Tip: Click inside the reader before using keyboard shortcuts if focus is currently in the search field or another control.

5. Fit and zoom

Fit Width sizes the page to the available reader width. Fit Height scales the page to fit vertically in the reader area. Actual uses the image’s actual-size display setting rather than fitting it to the viewport.

The magnifying-glass buttons at the far right decrease or increase the zoom. Use Fit Height for a complete page view or Fit Width when you prefer larger text and artwork.

6. Manga setup and right-to-left reading

Comic Zone supports manga reading direction through the Manga field in the Comic Info Editor. Select Yes (Right to Left) to make the reader use right-to-left navigation.

Setting up manga

  1. Select the comic in your library and open its Comic Info Editor.
  2. Open the Details tab.
  3. Find the Manga selection and choose Yes (Right to Left). The other options are Yes and No.
  4. Save your changes and open the comic in the reader.
  5. Use Single or Continuous reading mode as desired.

How the arrows change

When Yes (Right to Left) is selected, the navigation hint changes to ← next / → previous · Space = next. Press the Left Arrow key to advance, the Right Arrow key to go back, or Space to advance.

Note: Selecting Yes identifies the comic as manga, but choose Yes (Right to Left) specifically to enable reversed page navigation. This setting changes navigation direction; it does not fix incorrectly ordered pages within the archive.

Reading manga comfortably

Try Single + Fit Height to see the complete page, or Continuous for a scrollable reading experience. Follow the panel sequence on each manga page, generally from upper right toward left.

7. Double-page spreads

Some comics contain wide, two-page artwork. Use Fit Width or Fit Height to see the full spread without cutting off important details. When editing page order or identifying double pages, review the Thumbnails tab in the Comic Info Editor. How two separate pages are paired can depend on the reader version and comic layout.

8. Reading progress

Comic Zone tracks reading progress as you move through a comic. The library also offers a Read % metadata field, which can be used in Smart Lists to organize comics by reading progress.

For example, a Smart List can help identify comics you have started but have not finished.

9. Troubleshooting and tips

Page looks too small

Switch to Fit Width or use the zoom-in control.

Page is cut off

Choose Fit Height to see the whole page at once.

Arrow keys do not move pages

Click the reader to give it focus, and check whether you are in Single mode.

Manga pages appear in the wrong order

Check the comic archive’s page sequence and any page reordering in the Thumbnails tab. Select Yes (Right to Left) in the Details tab to reverse navigation. If the pages themselves are incorrectly sequenced, correct their order in the Thumbnails tab.

Scrolling feels different than expected

Confirm whether Single or Continuous is selected; they use different ways of moving through pages.
